meta.face: A small woman of about seventy, slightly stooped, with a small face broad at the cheekbones and tapering to a firm, pointed chin — a strong nose curving slightly downward, deep-set, hooded brown eyes under thin, low brows, prominent cheekbones and a wide, thin-lipped mouth in a warm, gentle smile; the face softly lined with age. Idealise the wrinkles into a few soft lines.
meta.basis: Her photographs from life (the Wikipedia lead photograph): the white sari with blue stripes over the head, the crucifix pinned at the left shoulder, a small lined face with a broad smile.
